blurb: 3 Palms Zoo is a rescue sanctuary for surrendered exotic pets and unreleasable wildlife. Visitors can hand-feed and interact with a variety of animals including foxes, alligators, farm animals, and prairie dogs. The zoo emphasizes a hands-on, informal experience without glass barriers, where animals roam freely and guests are encouraged to engage respectfully.
